source_state: uncommitted bounded-preview and ui-profiler implementation; binary predates final tooltip/formatting cleanup and export review corrections
build: release --features ui-profiler, same signed binary both modes

protocol.per_case: One row SQL executed through native UI; metrics reset; 30 native scripted x keypresses into trailing SQL comment, AX observation after each; metrics report. No forced redraw. Query-install observation separate.
protocol.profile: isolated generated SQLite fixture; no user database
protocol.parallel_work: No cargo/other benchmark during typing samples; desktop apps and OS caches remained
protocol.interpretation: Input histogram contains reset/control input as well as typing and may coalesce. Native scripted input is not physical IME validation. GPUI platform draw submission is not GPU completion or physical display. Draw samples include cursor/other redraws. Single sequential run per mode is descriptive, not statistical proof.

cases.sql: SELECT 1 AS id, printf('%.*c', 131072, 'x') AS payload;

query_install_observation.limitations: Root render/forced-redraw intervals are not key-to-paint/GPU presentation. Ranges describe rendered cells including partial/overscan, columns normalized after pinned ID. Accessibility semantics exist but VoiceOver/IME require native validation. No performance parity claim.

ui_profiler.limits: GPUI profiler build overhead included. Input may coalesce and includes keyboard/mouse/scroll; mid-draw events excluded. Platform draw submission does not prove GPU completion/physical display. Grid marker is root content paint, not query start or wire first row; last1024 samples.

native_checks.method: Value inspector original-copy button -> new TextEdit scratch document -> native paste; AX contained exactly 131072 consecutive x characters
native_checks.preview_ax: 256-byte escaped payload plus ellipsis and semantic/original-size label
native_checks.zero_row_200KiB_probe: Expected truncation before grid: SQLite retained cost counts text length*3 and exceeds 512KiB. Excluded from comparisons.
